## Work

- [AgriMate](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/agrimate): AI-assisted agricultural market intelligence platform designed for small and marginal farmers, powered by verified APMC mandi records for price clarity and crop forecasting.
- [PaarakhMetric](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/paarakhmetric): Mobile-first legal metrology and statutory compliance audit system for field inspectors. Features multimodal computer vision OCR, real-time Firebase sync, and automated digital seizure memos.
- [Drone Aero Lab](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/drone-aero-lab): A 3D flight assembler sandbox city featuring DJI drone configurations. Models lifting physics, payload weight adjustments, motor thrust, and drag factors.
- [Library System](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/library-system): An automated borrower and book inventory tracker with penalty and fine calculators. Created for freshman engineering programming labs using files operations.
- [Jan-Sathi](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/jan-sathi): Citizen helper eligibility portal matching government support options with profiles. Employs strong typed data validation fields for public schemes query.
- [AI Agents in Foundry](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/ai-agents-foundry): Autonomous multi-agent orchestration architecture utilizing Microsoft Foundry suite. Leverages cognitive vector search, structured tool bindings, and prompt execution graphs.
- [MLOps Architecture](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/mlops-pipeline): Comprehensive Machine Learning Operations lifecycle implementation covering data drift monitoring, automated retraining pipelines, experiment tracking, and production model serving.
- [Cloud Data Protection](https://shreyas-m.is-a.dev/projects/cloud-data-protection): Resilient cloud storage and data protection architecture designed for high-availability enterprise environments, with zero-trust role-based access control and snapshot redundancy.
